name: Real World VoiceEQ Benchmark
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: Human-rated leaderboards for voice AI, one tab per modality — Text-to-Speech, Speech-to-Speech, Speech Understanding, and ASR — plus an About tab (overview and one clickable card per panel). Each leaderboard tab is a heatmap of providers across that modality's factors: rows rank by the first column by default (the TTS tab's Overall score, else the first factor), clicking any column header re-sorts and re-ranks, and rows with no value in the active column sink to the bottom, unranked. (The SLM Judge meta-leaderboard lives in its own Space, built from the same dataset.)

requirements.text: Deploy with the hf CLI (pip install -U huggingfacehub, then hf auth login with write access to HumeAI), running the commands from this folder.
